note: Both sets are heavily duplicative and share the same misbinding of pitch sensitivity to a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' entity, but A keeps the key definitional facts better: it states the doubling relation with the correct condition (at θK) and includes the linear pitch-sensitivity/blade-pitch relation, whereas B labels the doubling relation 'at rated operating point' and twice truncates the quote to '∂θ (θ =0º) = ...'. B also misbinds pitch sensitivity and θK to 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch' and gives a clearly wrong -90E+6 watt/rad at the last data point (the plot shows about -120E+6 there). A's weak points are unsupported chart-read estimates (-105E+6 at max pitch angle, -30E+6 at 0º, -110E+6 at 20º, -25E+6 at 0º) whose quotes are only axis or legend labels.
